faqs.question: How can I book a room or highland tour?
faqs.answer: Use our Contact Us form or call our Gondar desk directly. Tell us your dates and how many guests are traveling.

faqs.question: Are rooms warm during cool highland evenings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every room has thick wool blankets and room heating, and our main lounge features a lit stone fireplace every evening.

faqs.question: Can you organize transport from Gondar Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer private car pickup from Gondar Airport and can arrange park vehicles for Simien Mountain day trips.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate group retreats and family holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes! We welcome families, hiking groups, and company retreats with custom meal plans and connecting rooms.

newsPosts.title: New Valley-View Restaurant Terrace Now Open
newsPosts.excerpt: Enjoy breakfast and evening coffee looking out across the northern hills.
newsPosts.body:
Guests at Highland Hotel can now dine on our sheltered stone terrace with wide views across the hills toward the Simien range.

We serve fresh local dishes, highland honey, and hot coffee roasted daily.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: Guided Simien Day Trips Available All Season
newsPosts.excerpt: Easy morning departures with local guides, water, and packed lunch.
newsPosts.body:
Our hotel guide team now runs small-group day trips from our lobby every morning after breakfast.

Whether you want a gentle scenic walk or a full ridge tour, we take care of transport and park entry.
newsPosts.author: Guest Relations

newsPosts.title: Heated Stone Lounge & Spa Hours Extended
newsPosts.excerpt: Warm evening steam sessions and massage slots now open until 9:00 PM.
newsPosts.body:
Returning guests can now unwind later in the evening with warm herbal steam and massage appointments after long drives or hikes.

Book at the front desk when you check in.
newsPosts.author: Hotel Management

blogPosts.title: Exploring Gondar's Royal Castles & Local Markets
blogPosts.excerpt: How to spend a relaxed day walking historic stone courtyards before evening dinner.
blogPosts.body:
Gondar blends rich centuries of Ethiopian history with friendly neighborhood streets.

Visit the historic stone enclosure in the morning while the air is cool, stop by local honey shops in the afternoon, and return to Highland Hotel in time for sunset over the hills.
blogPosts.author: Tadesse Alemu

blogPosts.title: Packing for Cool Highland Mornings in Northern Ethiopia
blogPosts.excerpt: Simple clothing and timing tips for bright daytime sun and crisp mountain nights.
blogPosts.body:
At over 2,100 meters elevation, highland weather changes quickly from warm midday sunshine to cool evenings.

Bring breathable layers for walking tours, comfortable closed walking shoes, and a warm sweater for relaxing on the evening terrace.
blogPosts.author: Selamawit Fekadu

blogPosts.title: Warm Highland Honey Tea & Evening Fireside Traditions
blogPosts.excerpt: Why guests gather around the stone fireplace every evening before dinner.
blogPosts.body:
White honey harvested in northern Ethiopian villages pairs wonderfully with spiced black tea after a day outdoors.

Our lounge lights the fireplace at 6:00 PM daily so travelers can warm up and share trip stories.
blogPosts.author: Mekdes Tesfaye
